privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This notice explains how Flying Ladders handles information in the game, on this website and when you contact support. It distinguishes information kept on your device from information used by optional connected features. The availability of sign-in, cloud saves, advertising and purchases depends on the released version and your choices.

sections.title: Who is responsible and how to contact us
paragraphs: Flying Ladders is provided by {{publisherName}}, based in {{publisherCountry}}. Contact {{privacyEmail}} for privacy questions or requests, and {{supportEmail}} for game support. Our correspondence address is {{publisherAddress}}. These details identify the game publisher; Apple, Google and Unity also have their own privacy responsibilities for the services they operate.

sections.title: Playing without a linked account
paragraphs: Your device stores your campaign progress, current puzzle and move history, level records, inventory, earned rewards, purchased entitlements, language and accessibility settings, tutorial history and reminder preferences. These files are used to resume play and prevent duplicate rewards. They are not uploaded by the local-save feature itself.

Uninstalling the game, clearing its storage or losing the device can remove local progress. A device backup operated by Apple or Google may separately include app data according to your device settings and those providers' terms. A local save is not a promise of a cloud backup. Optional network features can still contact their providers when enabled, even if you have not linked an Apple or Google identity.

sections.title: Optional sign-in and cloud progress
paragraphs: Players aged 16 or older can choose linked accounts when the feature is enabled in their build. Unity Authentication handles the game identity and links native Game Center or Google Play Games sign-in; older builds may use Unity Player Accounts. Unity Cloud Code handles authenticated account requests and stores connected profiles, progress, inventory, purchase ownership and deletion jobs in Unity Cloud Save Private Custom Data. The publisher does not ask for or receive your Apple or Google password. Players under 16 use local guest play without cloud sign-in or account linking.

Connected account data can include a game player identifier, provider linkage, authentication tokens managed by the SDK, a device/save namespace, your campaign state, records, settings included in the game profile, inventory, rewards, transaction grant records and sync revisions. The profile is processed to back up and reconcile progress, restore eligible entitlements and avoid crediting a reward twice. Connection metadata, including IP address, device/software details and service logs, may be processed by the service providers for delivery and security.

Linking and loading are separate choices when an existing account already has a save. Do not assume that signing in automatically combines every item from two saves. Linked saves may retain transaction and conflict-resolution records so that reconnection does not duplicate rewards. We do not use your sign-in to publish your scores, create a public profile or send promotional email.

sections.title: Payments, purchase verification and restoration
paragraphs: Apple App Store or Google Play handles payment and billing information. Flying Ladders does not receive your complete payment card details. To fulfill and verify a purchase, the game and its verification service may process the store, product identifier, transaction identifier, signed receipt or purchase token, app/package identifier, purchase status and a pseudonymous account association. Store receipts may contain additional store-supplied transaction details.

Verification and grant records issue the correct entitlement, record renewals or expiry, handle pending purchases and prevent duplicate grants or fraud. Purchase proofs may be encrypted in the verification service. The current catalog offers consumable coin packs and weekly, monthly or yearly subscriptions that remove automatic ads between levels while active. Optional reward videos remain, and coins are not included in a subscription. The older permanent ad-removal purchase is supported for eligible restoration only and is no longer sold. Restore purchases retrieves eligible active subscriptions and legacy entitlements for the same store account; it does not recreate coin packs. A remaining game balance can be recovered separately through a successfully synchronized game account.

Do not email us passwords, full payment card details or authentication tokens. For support, a transaction/order reference and your game player identifier are normally enough to start an investigation. Apple and Google control their own purchase histories and refund processing.

When rewarded advertising is offered, a reward-intent identifier and provider confirmation may be processed to check that the reward was earned and prevent duplicate claims. Connected purchase or reward processing can use a local installation reference even if you play as a guest; guest play does not mean every optional network feature is disabled.

sections.title: Advertising and your privacy choices
paragraphs: When advertising is enabled, Flying Ladders uses Google AdMob and the Google User Messaging Platform to request ads and collect applicable privacy choices. Depending on the platform, region, consent and SDK configuration, Google and its advertising partners may process IP address, approximate location inferred from it, advertising or other device identifiers, device/software information, ad views and interactions, diagnostics and fraud-prevention signals. An ad partner may use its own technologies and privacy policy.

Where consent is required, the consent flow determines whether ads may be requested. Where applicable, Advertising privacy in the game reopens privacy options. On iOS, tracking permission is governed separately by the operating system when tracking is used; declining it must not be represented as permission to track. Contextual or limited ads can still involve operational processing and are not necessarily data-free.

An active ad-removal subscription suppresses automatic ads between levels for its verified period. An eligible restored legacy ad-removal purchase also suppresses automatic ads. Optional rewarded offers may remain available if the game shows them and you choose to view one. We do not make a reward video a condition of permission to play. Advertising choices may need to be made again on another device. Production ad availability depends on the build and release configuration.

sections.title: Local reminders, permissions and device controls
paragraphs: Flying Ladders can schedule local reminders on your device. They start disabled; the game asks the operating system for permission only after you turn reminders on in Settings. If permission is denied, reminders stay disabled until you choose otherwise. You can change the game setting or the operating system's notification settings at any time. Reminders are scheduled locally and do not use a publisher-operated remote push service.

Notifications are queued on the device for the next 14 days and refreshed when you return to the game. Some evening messages may include the number of paths cleared in your local save. Notification text may be visible on your lock screen according to your device settings. The schedule and progress count stay on the device; Flying Ladders does not register for a remote push service or send reminder data to a server. Sound, haptics and presentation effects use the corresponding device capabilities. The game does not need access to your contacts, photos, precise location, microphone or camera for its core puzzle play. Optional device-motion presentation is local and does not determine puzzle rules.

sections.title: Website, cookies and optional measurement
paragraphs: The website is hosted on Vercel. Its account-deletion form submits a short-lived code through our Cloudflare gateway to Unity Cloud Code. Cloudflare forwards verified store and advertising callbacks and protects public endpoints; it is not the game-profile database. Hosting providers can process ordinary request information, such as IP address, requested URL, time, browser information and security logs, to deliver and protect their services. Fonts and artwork on the website are self-hosted.

The website uses browser storage for preferences you choose, such as pausing decorative motion and remembering cookie choices. The interactive puzzle example runs in your browser and does not submit its moves to a server. It does not sign you in to the game.

This marketing site currently has no audience-measurement provider enabled. If optional measurement is introduced, it will be identified in the cookie settings and will require consent where applicable. You can continue browsing without it. Browser preferences remember motion and privacy choices. Store, sign-in and account-service links take you to a separate service with its own data processing; the browser puzzle does not send moves to your game account.

sections.title: Support correspondence
paragraphs: When you contact us, we process the contact details you supply, your message and any optional screenshots, device/app version, game identifier or purchase reference you include. We use this information to respond, investigate a fault, address a purchase problem or fulfill a privacy request. Send only information relevant to the issue. Support links create an email in your own mail application; this website does not silently upload a form or create a support ticket.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Where EU, EEA or UK data-protection law applies, processing necessary to provide the game or a requested connected feature is generally based on performance of our agreement with you. Security, duplicate-grant prevention, service reliability and resolving support issues can be based on legitimate interests, subject to the balancing and safeguards required by law. Records required for tax, accounting, lawful requests or consumer protection are processed to comply with legal obligations.

Optional tracking, advertising personalization or website measurement relies on consent where required. You can withdraw consent through the relevant privacy controls without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing. The exact role and legal basis of an independent service provider is described in its own notice. We do not treat acceptance of Terms as blanket consent to optional tracking.

sections.title: Who can receive information
paragraphs: Relevant information may be processed by Unity for authentication, connected game services and private cloud storage; Cloudflare for request security and notification, purchase-verification and deletion routing; Vercel for the website; Google for Play billing, sign-in, AdMob and consent tools; Apple for App Store billing, sign-in and device services; and providers or personnel helping answer support requests. Access is limited to the service purpose. Data may also be disclosed when required by law, to protect legal rights or security, or in a legitimate business transfer with appropriate notice and safeguards.

We do not offer your game save for sale. Advertising-provider processing can fall within legal definitions of sharing or targeted advertising in some jurisdictions. Your applicable choices must be respected; a general statement about not selling saves does not remove those rights. We do not disclose more information than is reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

sections.title: International processing and security
paragraphs: Our providers may process information in countries other than where you live. When a restricted international transfer is made, an appropriate lawful safeguard must be used, such as an adequacy decision or approved contractual safeguards. You can ask the publisher for details relevant to your data; provider-specific transfer information is also in the notices linked below.

We use platform authentication, encrypted transport for connected services, server-side purchase verification and access controls to protect information. No system can guarantee absolute security or permanent availability. Keep your store and identity accounts secure. If you believe an account or purchase has been compromised, contact support and the relevant provider promptly.

sections.title: How long information is kept
paragraphs: Local files remain on your device until replaced, deleted, removed with the app or affected by device backup/restore settings. Connected progress is retained while needed to provide the requested account and recovery features, unless you request deletion or a shorter applicable period requires removal. Support information is retained only for the issue and justified follow-up or recordkeeping needs.

Necessary purchase, fraud-prevention or legal records may be retained after deletion to meet legal obligations, resolve disputes or prevent duplicate claims. The deletion process keeps limited keyed, nonreversible ownership and deletion fingerprints to stop purchase replay and prevent a deleted profile from being recreated by a delayed request. It does not retain the deleted playable profile for that purpose. Retained records must be limited to the justified purpose and access restricted. Contact us for the retention applicable to your request; different records do not share a single fixed deletion period.

sections.title: Your rights, deletion and complaints
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you can request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or objection, and withdraw consent. You may also have rights concerning targeted advertising, sale or sharing and automated decisions. Flying Ladders does not use your puzzle performance to make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. We do not discriminate against you for exercising applicable privacy rights.

Send a request to {{privacyEmail}} and include enough information to locate the game account. We may ask for proportionate verification to prevent another person from deleting your save. Never provide your password. We respond within the period required by applicable law and explain any lawful reason for retaining limited records or declining a request. You can complain to the relevant data-protection authority; EU, EEA and UK users may contact their local supervisory authority.

Use the account tools in the game to start linked-account deletion. If the game provides a short-lived, single-use code, enter it only on {{accountDeletionUrl}}. If you cannot access the game, contact {{privacyEmail}} for verified assistance. A confirmed deletion blocks account use and removes the connected profile, progress, checkpoints, inventory and associated rewards. Cleanup of linked Unity Authentication and legacy Cloud Save records can remain pending while a provider is unavailable and is retried. We explain the status and any limited lawful retention on request. Uninstalling or clearing a local save does not delete an existing cloud account. Game-account deletion does not delete your global Apple, Google or Unity Player Accounts identity, erase store purchase history, cancel a subscription or automatically refund a purchase. Cancel renewal separately in your store settings.

To manage or delete the global Unity Player Account used for sign-in, use https://player-account.unity.com/delete-account. For access to data held by Unity Player Accounts, contact unity-player-login-privacy@unity3d.com. These provider tools are separate from the Flying Ladders profile-deletion process described above. Deleting a global Unity identity alone does not confirm deletion of game data held by the publisher.

sections.title: Children and family use
paragraphs: The game is intended for a mixed audience from age 9. Follow the age rating and audience information in your store listing and use parental purchase and device controls where appropriate. A store rating is not consent to collect personal information, and the game is not designated as an Apple Made for Kids app.

At first launch, the game asks “Are you 16 or older?” with Yes and No choices. It does not ask for a birth date. The answer stays on the device and can be reset in Settings; it is not included in the connected profile. Cloud sign-in and advertising do not initialize before an answer. Players under 16 use local guest play without linked accounts or cloud saves. Players aged 16 or older can choose available connected features.

When ads are enabled for a player under 16, the game requests child-directed treatment, limits ad content to Google’s G rating and disables publisher first-party identifiers. Optional ad personalization is not requested for these players. Consent, regional rules and provider settings may further restrict advertising. Limited or contextual ads can still involve operational processing. This age choice does not replace parental consent where it is legally required.

We do not knowingly collect a child’s personal information contrary to applicable law. A parent or guardian can contact {{privacyEmail}} to ask about a child’s data or request deletion. Store purchases remain subject to Apple or Google controls; optional guest purchases can still require store and receipt-verification processing as described above.

sections.title: Provider notices and policy changes
paragraphs: Provider notices: Unity (https://unity.com/legal/game-player-and-app-user-privacy-policy), Google (https://policies.google.com/privacy), Google advertising technologies (https://policies.google.com/technologies/ads), Apple (https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/), Cloudflare (https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) and Vercel (https://vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy). These describe provider-specific processing and do not replace this notice of the game’s actual data flows.

We may update this policy when features, providers or legal requirements change. The date at the top identifies the current version. Material changes require appropriate notice, and new consent where required; they are not retroactively treated as permission for unrelated processing. A copy of the policy is available within the game, including when the device is offline.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms describe the relationship between you and the Flying Ladders publisher for the game, this website and optional connected features. They explain purchases, saves and fair use. Mandatory consumer and privacy rights remain in place.

sections.title: Publisher and agreement
paragraphs: Flying Ladders is provided by {{publisherName}}, based in {{publisherCountry}}, with correspondence address {{publisherAddress}}. Contact {{supportEmail}} for questions about these Terms. The version date is shown at the top. By using the game where these Terms are presented as part of its agreement, you agree to them to the extent permitted by applicable law. Privacy information is provided separately in the Privacy Policy; these Terms do not grant optional advertising or tracking consent.

If you cannot legally enter into this agreement, a parent or guardian must authorize your use where required. Follow the store's age rating, local eligibility requirements and parental controls. If you do not agree, do not use the game or connected features. This does not waive any right to a refund or remedy that the law or your store gives you.

sections.title: Your license to play
paragraphs: The publisher grants you a personal, limited, non-exclusive and non-transferable license to install and use an authorized copy of Flying Ladders for lawful personal entertainment, subject to these Terms and the applicable store rules. The game, artwork, characters, music, writing, software and branding remain the property of their respective rights holders. Buying an item does not transfer ownership of those materials.

You may share your own ordinary gameplay screenshots or recordings for personal discussion and non-misleading coverage, subject to lawful third-party rights and platform rules. Do not present yourself as the publisher, remove ownership notices, redistribute game assets as a competing product, or use the artwork for unrelated commercial merchandise without permission. Rights that applicable law grants for interoperability, accessibility, criticism or other lawful uses are not removed by these Terms.

sections.title: Puzzle play, updates and connected availability
paragraphs: Flying Ladders is a single-player puzzle game in which one persistent row is reordered across platforms to an exact receiver target. Shape, word and mixed modes can have separate progression. Mechanics, difficulty and content may be adjusted to fix faults and improve play, but the publisher must not misrepresent what a paid product provides.

Core local play and optional connected features have different availability. Sign-in, synchronization, purchase verification and ads require the relevant provider, configuration and network connection. We may maintain or update those services. No uninterrupted connection, permanent cloud retention, fixed future content schedule or guaranteed score is promised. We will give notice of significant changes where required and respect paid entitlements and mandatory remedies.

This website's small reorder example illustrates the core idea. It is not the full mobile game and does not synchronize its moves or rewards to your account. Promotional artwork is illustrative; native gameplay images show the referenced version, which may change with updates.

sections.title: Accounts, security and saves
paragraphs: Players aged 16 or older can choose Apple or Google sign-in through Unity Player Accounts when available in their build. Players under 16 use local guest play without account linking or cloud saves. Keep your identity and store accounts secure and use information you are authorized to provide. Contact support if you believe your game account has been compromised. Do not share passwords or authentication tokens with the publisher. The local age choice does not replace parental authorization where required by law.

Local progress is stored on the device and can be lost if storage is removed or the device is lost. Linking an account is optional where the game permits local play. Cloud backup is available only after the connected feature is enabled and synchronization succeeds. Review any account-choice screen before loading an existing account. Two saves do not automatically create a combined balance or duplicate entitlements.

Support may require a player identifier and transaction reference to investigate a lost purchase. The publisher cannot restore a save that was never backed up or recover an account controlled solely by another provider without that provider's verification. Use the data-request contact in the Privacy Policy to request game-data deletion; uninstalling and deleting an external identity are different actions.

sections.title: Purchases and virtual items
paragraphs: When purchases are available, the price, currency, renewal period and product description shown by Apple App Store or Google Play before confirmation control the purchase. Your store processes payment under its own terms. The current catalog offers consumable coin packs and weekly, monthly and yearly auto-renewing ad-removal subscriptions. The store may offer only products available for your build and region; a website illustration is not a live purchase offer.

Coins, tools, rewards and cosmetics are for use inside Flying Ladders. They have no cash value, are not a bank deposit or investment, and cannot be redeemed for money or transferred outside supported game features. Do not sell or exchange accounts, balances or items through unauthorized services. A cosmetic trophy changes appearance; tools can have a described gameplay effect. Read the item's cost, limits and consequence before using it.

A consumable is used up when spent. Each ad-removal subscription provides the same benefit for its selected period: no automatic ads between levels while the verified subscription is active. Optional reward videos remain available; coins and other paid items are not included. The older permanent ad-removal purchase is no longer offered for sale, but eligible owners can restore it under the store’s rules. Purchases use store billing, not card details sent to this website. An order may stay pending until the store and verifier confirm it.

Subscriptions renew automatically until renewal is cancelled through the store account. The store shows the applicable price and billing period before confirmation. Manage or cancel Apple subscriptions at https://support.apple.com/en-us/118428 or Google Play subscriptions at https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481. Cancellation generally stops future renewal; the store determines remaining access, effective dates and any refund. On Apple platforms, cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends to avoid renewal. Uninstalling the game, deleting a local save or deleting the game account does not cancel a subscription. Any trial, introductory offer or price change is governed by the terms shown by the store; none is promised by this website.

sections.title: Restoration, refunds and problems
paragraphs: Restore purchases requests eligible entitlements from the current store account. Use the same Apple or Google store account that made the purchase. Eligible active subscriptions and the legacy permanent ad-removal purchase can be restored after verification. An expired subscription does not provide current ad removal. Coin packs are not reissued by Restore. Successfully synchronized remaining inventory may be recovered separately through a linked game account; local-only progress is not a cloud backup.

Refunds and cancellation requests follow the relevant store process and applicable consumer law. Nothing in these Terms removes mandatory refund, conformity, withdrawal or other consumer rights. Digital-content withdrawal rules and any required consent are governed by law and the platform's purchase process; we do not assume that merely playing waives them. If an entitlement is refunded, revoked or found invalid, the game may remove the corresponding entitlement according to store rules and lawful safeguards.

For a missing item, avoid repurchasing until the issue is investigated. Contact {{supportEmail}} with your platform, app version, game identifier if available and store order reference. Never send a password or full card details. The publisher can investigate fulfillment but cannot override Apple or Google's own account or billing controls.

sections.title: Ads, reminders and choices
paragraphs: If the released version includes ads, automatic ads must appear at appropriate transitions rather than interrupting an active puzzle. An optional rewarded offer describes what can be earned before you choose it. An interrupted or unverified ad may not produce a reward. Advertising providers operate under their own policies and the privacy choices applicable to you.

Local reminders require operating-system permission. You can disable them in the game or device settings without losing the license to play. Optional tracking or measurement consent is separate from these Terms and can be declined or withdrawn through the appropriate controls. We do not treat a notification permission as consent to advertising profiling.

sections.title: Fair use and prohibited conduct
paragraphs: Do not interfere with service security, impersonate another person, submit fraudulent receipts, exploit a defect to repeatedly obtain paid items, manipulate server grants, use stolen accounts, introduce malicious code, or intentionally damage another user's access. Do not bypass a lawful payment or access control. Automated security research or interoperability permitted by law remains subject to the applicable legal safeguards.

If you discover a serious fault, report it privately to {{supportEmail}} with enough information to reproduce it without exposing another person's data. The publisher may investigate suspected abuse and restrict connected features proportionately where justified. We do not promise to remove legitimate offline progress merely because a network request failed, and an adverse action can be raised with support.

sections.title: Support, suspension and ending use
paragraphs: You can stop playing, uninstall the app and request game-account deletion through the in-game account tools, {{accountDeletionUrl}} or verified support assistance. Deleting a game account does not cancel a store subscription, delete your global identity-provider account or erase lawful store billing records. Cancel renewal separately in your store settings. Deletion can include pending provider cleanup as described in the Privacy Policy. The publisher can suspend connected access for a material violation, security incident, legal obligation or service discontinuation, with notice and a chance to resolve the issue where appropriate and feasible.

Restrictions should be proportionate to the issue. Where a service or paid feature is materially discontinued, the publisher must respect applicable consumer rights and any required remedy. Contact {{supportEmail}} to challenge a restriction or ask for help. Do not send sensitive credentials as proof.

sections.title: Faults, responsibility and mandatory rights
paragraphs: We aim to provide a functional game and correct faults, but software can contain errors and services can be temporarily unavailable. To the extent permitted by law, features are supplied as described for the released version, without an additional guarantee that every device, future operating-system update or network condition will be supported.

Nothing excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable liability for fraud, intentional misconduct, personal injury, gross negligence or mandatory consumer remedies. For other claims, responsibility is limited only to the extent permitted by the law that applies to you. These Terms do not impose a blanket waiver of rights, mandatory arbitration or an invented monetary liability cap. Back up recoverable progress and report a fault before relying on repeated purchases to solve it.

sections.title: Apple, Google and other provider terms
paragraphs: Your store and identity provider have separate agreements for their services. For an App Store distribution where Apple's standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement applies, it also governs the license subject to the platform's rules: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/. These Terms do not appoint the publisher to act on behalf of Apple, Google or Unity or override their mandatory conditions.

Apple is not responsible for providing Flying Ladders support beyond the responsibilities assigned to it by the applicable store agreement and law. Google is not the game publisher. Claims about the game should go to the publisher; billing and provider-account issues may require the relevant platform. Links on the website do not imply that those providers endorse Flying Ladders.

sections.title: Applicable law, disputes and changes
paragraphs: The publisher's country is {{publisherCountry}}. The applicable rules for a dispute depend on that jurisdiction and any mandatory protections in your place of residence. These Terms do not take away a consumer's right to rely on mandatory local law or access a competent court. Please contact {{supportEmail}} first so we can try to resolve an issue directly; doing so is not a condition that removes a legal right.

We may revise these Terms for a change in the game, providers or legal obligations. Material changes require appropriate notice and, where required, a new agreement. We do not retroactively change a completed purchase's description. If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions apply to the extent lawful. The Privacy Policy remains the separate notice for personal information.
